name: YTLPOWR
recent: YTL Power 近期因 Nvidia 相关市场波动而受到关注，股价出现回调，同时 EPF 持续申报持股变动。公司也通过凭单转换和 ESOS 行使持续增加股本，并发布了 2026 年报及第 30 届常年股东大会通知。
notable: 凭单转换为普通股，发行 89,820 股新股，发行价 RM2.45，于 2026 年 11 月 13 日上市。
ESOS 行使发行 57,000 股新股，发行价 RM0.51，于 2026 年 11 月 10 日上市。
发布 2026 年报及第 30 届常年股东大会通知，会议定于 2026 年 12 月 3 日举行。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
近期新闻显示，Nvidia 相关市场动荡导致 YTL Power 股价承压并出现回调。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 6,325,340,000，净利为 MYR 423,504,000，净利率 6.7%。营收环比增长 24.4%，净利环比增长 30.0%；营收同比增长 14.0%，但净利同比下降 48.2%。

recent_en: YTL Power has recently drawn attention amid Nvidia-related market volatility, with its share price pulling back, while EPF continues to file changes in its shareholdings. The company also continues to increase its share capital through warrant conversions and ESOS exercises, and has released its 2026 annual report and notice of the 30th AGM.
notable_en: Conversion of warrants into ordinary shares involving 89,820 new shares at an issue price of RM2.45, listed on 13 November 2026.
Exercise of ESOS options involving 57,000 new shares at an issue price of RM0.51, listed on 10 November 2026.
Release of the 2026 annual report and notice of the 30th AGM, scheduled for 3 December 2026.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its shareholdings between October and November 2026.
Recent news indicates that Nvidia-related market turmoil has put pressure on YTL Power's share price, leading to a pullback.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 6,325,340,000 and net income was MYR 423,504,000, with a net margin of 6.7%. Revenue rose 24.4% QoQ and net income rose 30.0% QoQ; revenue grew 14.0% YoY, while net income fell 48.2% YoY.
